findings.description: Proposed `z.union([Stdio, Http]).passthrough()` accepts `{ command, url }` simultaneously because each branch allows extras via `.passthrough()`. The codex Rust `RawMcpServerConfig` (`codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs/config/src/mcp_types.rs:274-325`) rejects cross-transport fields. Loader must enforce XOR via `.superRefine()` or explicit branch refinement, and a test must cover ambiguous-entry rejection.
findings.resolution: Schema now adds `.superRefine()` enforcing command-XOR-url; helper unit test covers `{ command, url }` ambiguity (logged + skipped); plan documents the rejection contract.

findings.description: `plans/overview.html` update is under-specified. Per `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md:81-164` (procedure B), shipping a task requires: flip cmd badge class `b-inflight` → `b-closed` and emoji `🟡 in progress` → `✅ shipped`; add a `runs[]` entry with commit SHA + ISO timestamp + outcome; bump `lastTouched[<taskId>]`; bump `generatedAt` and `generatedFromCommit`. Embedded JSON at `plans/overview.html:1900-1908,1944-1952`. Plan currently only says 'flip the row'.
findings.resolution: Implementation Strategy step 4 (overview.html) now lists the six SKILL.md-mandated edits explicitly with file:line references.

findings.description: Docs-flip scope misses `plans/codex-agent-parity-audit.md:63-82,341`, which still documents the .mcp.json gap as an active High item and recommends shipping mcp-discovery first. Without this update the audit doc goes stale.
findings.resolution: Added `plans/codex-agent-parity-audit.md` to the Files-to-Modify list with explicit edit instructions for the L63-82 and L341 references.

findings.description: `runs[].commits` and `generatedFromCommit` in `plans/overview.html` require the landing commit SHA, but the SHA does not exist until the commit lands. Plan currently mandates one atomic commit without explaining how the SHA is captured. Either accept a follow-up amend (`git commit --amend` once with the SHA, still one commit at HEAD) or accept a sentinel/placeholder.
findings.resolution: Acceptance Criteria 9 now allows a single `--amend` after the initial commit to fold the resolved SHA into `overview.html` runs[].commits and generatedFromCommit. End-state is still a single commit at HEAD; the amend is explicit and documented. Test+typecheck assertions are run BEFORE the initial commit so the amend is metadata-only.

findings.description: Acceptance only covers passthrough of HTTP extras on a valid HTTP entry. Should also cover that ambiguous entries (`{ command, url }`) and transport-incompatible-extra entries are skipped with a warning.
findings.resolution: Helper unit tests now include: `{ command, url }` ambiguous entry rejected with warning; transport-incompatible-extras (stdio-only `args` on http entry) handled per superRefine policy (explicitly documented).

findings.description: Existing `runCodex.fork.test.ts` mocks `./resumeExistingThread` — copying that harness would only prove the wrapper received `mcpServers`, not that `resumeExistingThread.ts:20-33` forwarded them to `client.resumeThread`. Test (d) should NOT mock `./resumeExistingThread`; assert against `client.resumeThread` mock directly.
findings.resolution: Tests section now explicitly states test (d) must NOT mock `./resumeExistingThread` — uses the real forwarder and asserts on `client.resumeThread` mock call args.

findings.description: 'broken-JSON or invalid-shape' for the malformed start-path test conflates two distinct branches. Pick one concrete fixture (broken JSON) for the runCodex integration test to avoid implementer ambiguity; helper tests already cover both.
findings.resolution: Acceptance Criterion 3 now specifies broken-JSON fixture for the runCodex integration test; helper unit tests still cover both branches separately.

findings.description: `tee /tmp/codexu-mcp-disc.log` is Bash-shaped; on Windows-first workflow this needs Git-Bash or a Windows-safe path. The original feature request specified this exact command so it stays for traceability, but plan should note the implementer may substitute a repo-relative log path if the shell requires it.
findings.resolution: Acceptance Criterion 6 keeps the original command verbatim per the feature request, but adds a parenthetical noting that the implementer may substitute a repo-relative log path on shells where /tmp isn't writable.

findings.description: Verification confirmed roadmap convention is `- ✅ ` prefix (no strikethrough, no date suffix). Open Question can be resolved.
findings.resolution: Open Question replaced with the resolved convention; Implementation Strategy step 4 now explicitly says 'prefix with `- ✅ ` and keep existing bullet text'.

findings.description: Verification confirmed `packages/happy-cli/CLAUDE.md` has NO existing 'Delivered' subsection. Cleanest action is to delete the open-gap bullet at L236-258 entirely (or replace with a one-line inline annotation referencing the roadmap).
findings.resolution: Open Question resolved; Implementation Strategy step 4 now says: delete the open-gap bullet (or replace with a one-line `### Codex Agent Feature Parity` note pointing at the closed roadmap bullet).

findings.description: Verification confirmed that `codexAppServerClient.ts` `resumeThread` already uses `opts?.mcpServers ?? defaults.mcpServers` (L1172) so persisted snapshot covers reconnect without additional plumbing. Plan's assumption is correct and worth stating explicitly.
findings.resolution: Technical Constraints now explicitly cites the L1172 fallback line so future maintainers see why no reconnect-path edit is needed.
